ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {OTHER_nameDef} to answer to {PAWN_objective}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist who loves animals and has none of their own wants one of the colony's animals that answers to nobody yet.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_nameDef} is master of an animal, or bonded to one. Set {OTHER_nameDef}'s master in the Animals tab, or promise it.

plain.li: Nobody gives {OTHER_nameDef} orders. Let me. I'll take {OTHER_objective} out every morning.
I've been feeding {OTHER_nameDef} scraps for a week. I think we've already decided, the two of us.
[winter] Long cold days with nothing to do but chores. I'd like an animal to teach, and {OTHER_nameDef} needs somebody.
[lowmood] I'd like something that's glad to see me. {OTHER_nameDef} would do.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} follows whoever has food. I'd like to be the one {OTHER_pronoun} follows for no reason at all.

blunt.li: Make me {OTHER_nameDef}'s master. Nobody else is using {OTHER_objective}.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and me, a team! I'll teach {OTHER_objective} everything.

gloomy.li: Everyone here has someone. I'd settle for {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: An animal without a master learns nothing. Assign {OTHER_nameDef} to me and I'll train {OTHER_objective} properly.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came when I called. Well, {OTHER_pronoun} came eventually.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} slept by my door last night. I think {OTHER_pronoun} knows.

plain.li: Never mind. {OTHER_nameDef} seems happy enough with the herd.

gloomy.li: Even the animals answer to somebody else.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a barn for the herd
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: The colony's herd sleeps out in the weather. Someone who looks after the animals wants a barn: a room with beds or sleeping spots for them.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The herd's barn is gone, and the animals sleep out in the weather again.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: A barn (a room for animals) with beds or sleeping spots for {TARGET} of the herd. Plan one from the barn layout.

plain.li: The herd sleeps in the rain. A roof, some straw and a door that shuts. That's all a barn is.
I counted the herd last night by lantern, standing in the mud. I'd like to count them dry next time.
[winter] The animals huddle up against the wall in the snow. We lose condition on every one of them like that.
[rain] Listen to it. The herd's out in that, all night.
[skill:Animals] Animals that sleep dry give more and fall ill less. A barn pays for itself.

warm.li: They work for us all day. The least we can do is keep the rain off them at night.

blunt.li: Build the herd a barn before we lose one to the cold.

cheerful.li: A barn! With straw, and stalls, and a name over every one!

gloomy.li: One cold night and we'll be burying one of them. Then we'll build the barn.

cold.li: Livestock kept in the open loses weight and falls sick. A barn is the cheaper choice.

plain.li: The whole herd under one roof. I stood in the doorway and listened to them settle.

warm.li: Warm and dry. They know it, too. You can tell by how they sleep.

cheerful.li: I've named every stall. Don't change them.

cold.li: The herd is housed. Expect better yields.

plain.li: Out in the weather again tonight, all of them. I'll go and check on them later.

blunt.li: No barn. Fine. Don't blame me when one dies of cold.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: something to ride
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist who hunts, travels or can't keep still wants an animal of their own they can ride. Only with Giddy-Up 2, which decides what can be ridden.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef}'s mount answers to someone else now.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_nameDef} is master of an animal that can be ridden (Giddy-Up says which). Something like {SUBJECT} would do.

plain.li: I walk to the edge of the map and back twice a day. Something with four legs could do it in half the time.
Give me {SUBJECT} to ride and I'll bring the game home before it spoils.
[skill:Shooting] A rider sees the herd before the herd sees the rider. I'd hunt better from a saddle.
I need to get out past the hills sometimes. On foot it's a day there and back.

warm.li: I'd look after it well. Brush it every evening, the lot.

blunt.li: I want something to ride: {SUBJECT}, or anything with a broad back.

cheerful.li: Imagine riding in at the gate at a gallop! Everyone would stop and look.

gloomy.li: My knees won't last forever. I'd like to see the far hills once more while they do.

cold.li: A mounted colonist covers three times the ground. It's a sound investment.

plain.li: Rode out to the river and back before breakfast. My legs are going to hate me.

cheerful.li: Did you see us? Did everyone see us?
